title: Antisymmetry Condition
description: Essential Criteria: The wave function must satisfy the antisymmetry condition for identical fermions.

title: Pauli Exclusion Principle
description: Important Criteria: Explain how the antisymmetry condition leads to the Pauli exclusion principle.

title: Possible L and S Values
description: Essential Criteria: Identify the possible values of L and S for the given electron configuration.

title: Spatial Wave Function Form
description: Important Criteria: Provide the correct form of the spatial part of the wave functions using the single-particle functions.

title: Lowest Energy State Reasoning
description: Important Criteria: Justify which state has the lowest energy and explain the reasoning.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for sign mistakes in the antisymmetry condition or wave function expressions.

title: Missing Quantum Numbers
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all quantum numbers are correctly identified and stated.
